title: Scholarship Program
lead: Empowering the future of Cambodian children through merit and need-based scholarships.

items.title: School fees
items.body: Full tuition for primary, lower-secondary and upper-secondary years.

items.title: Learning materials
items.body: Books, uniforms, stationery and digital devices where needed.

blocks.title: Eligibility
paragraphs: Currently enrolled in a KAPE-partner school.
From a vulnerable or low-income household.

title: Volunteer with KAPE
lead: Give your time and skills to Cambodian education — on the ground or remotely.

items.title: Field volunteer
items.body: Spend a season working alongside teachers in NGS or HCC partner schools.

items.title: Reading coach
items.body: Help us run library and read-aloud sessions in primary schools.

items.title: Digital mentor
items.body: Coach students and teachers on digital literacy — onsite or online.

items.title: Translation & content
items.body: Translate stories and reports between Khmer and English from anywhere.
